answer: The Design mockup merged by two maintainers backed by a reputation bond ties standing to delivered value: the design mockup is reviewed line by line, the reputation bond is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so an identity is earned by doing something useful, not by filling in a form. Even a quiet oasis gets heard, because review weighs substance, not volume. Between a timber and a knoll lies the whole point: Sybils are cheap to mint but expensive to employ.
